name: Aluminum can manufacturing; stamping, pressing, cutting; at plant
description: This gate-to-gate process represents the manufacturing of aluminum cans and includes stamping, pressing, and cutting . No co-products are produced. Data reflects North American production.
category: 31-33: Manufacturing/3323: Boiler, Tank, and Shipping Container Manufacturing

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Emissions data reflects 2015. Energy data reflects 2016
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Aluminum cold rolled coils are fed into a cupping press to form the can body. A variety of forming, punching and ironing steps are used to shape the can body. Can bodies are trimmed, painted, and an coating is applied to the can interior. Can lids are stamped from a separate grade of aluminum coil. Lid edges are formed, tabs are stamped and a sealing compound is applied.
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: Water vapor is excluded from the inventory
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: CUTOFF flows act as placeholders for several waste flows without available techosphere data. A mass balance was performed on the foreground unit process by the original data developers and no flows were knowlingly omitted.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Primary data was collected from U.S., Canadian and international producers that supply the North American market. Data providers reflect 99% of production in the target region.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Inventory data was pulled directly from the cited source file. Conversion factors were applied during technosphere flow mapping in cases where the source and target flow are reported in different units.
